control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: kinetic release during transfer operations on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on P-3222, M-3222 and PT-3222 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 16 November 2023 an incident occurred on P-3222, M-3222 and PT-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
